description:
Citi is looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to join its Technology team and play a meaningful role in building, enhancing, and securing the application systems that power one of the world's leading financial institutions. In this intermediate-level engineering role, you will contribute directly to the design and implementation of software solutions while collaborating across technology and business teams to deliver real impact. This is an opportunity to operate with genuine autonomy, apply your engineering skills to complex challenges, and grow your career within a global organization.
  
 Responsibilities 
 Design and develop system enhancements by applying knowledge of application development procedures, scripting tools, and code analysis to deliver effective software solutions.
 Build and support customer-facing systems by collaborating with users, clients, and cross-functional technology teams to identify needs and implement reliable programming solutions.
 Apply programming language fundamentals to translate functional requirements into clear, well-structured design specifications.
 Analyze applications to detect vulnerabilities and security risks, conducting thorough testing and debugging to ensure software integrity.
 Identify root causes of technical issues and implement solutions drawn from hands-on engineering experience, resolving problems efficiently and accurately.
 Act as a subject matter expert for senior stakeholders and team members, providing guidance and mentoring junior analysts to raise overall team capability.
 Evaluate technical and business decisions with a focus on risk awareness, ensuring that solutions uphold compliance standards and reflect sound engineering judgement.
  
 Required Qualifications & Skills 
 2 or more years of software engineering experience, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables.
 Practical knowledge of application development concepts, programming languages, and software design principles.
 Demonstrated ability to analyze complex problems, evaluate options, and implement well-reasoned technical solutions.
 Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to shifting requirements in a fast-paced environment.
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field.
  
 Beneficial Skills & Qualifications 
 Experience working within the financial services industry, with an understanding of the regulatory and operational environment in which technology solutions are delivered.
 Familiarity with security analysis practices and vulnerability assessment within enterprise application environments.
 Experience advising or mentoring junior engineers, contributing to team development and knowledge sharing.
 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  
 What We Offer 
  
 At Citi, engineers work on meaningful technology at global scale, with access to the tools, teams, and development opportunities needed to grow their careers. Based in Tampa, FL, you will join a collaborative, performance-driven environment where your contributions have a direct impact on the systems and clients that matter.
 A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing flexibility while maintaining strong team connection.
 Exposure to complex, large-scale technology challenges within one of the world's most prominent financial institutions.
 Clear pathways for career development and progression, supported by ongoing learning opportunities and access to a broad technology organization.
 A collaborative team environment where engineers are empowered to take ownership, share knowledge, and grow their technical expertise.
 Wellbeing support and work-life balance initiatives designed to help you perform at your best, both professionally and personally.
 Competitive compensation and financial wellbeing benefits befitting a global financial organization.
  
 Apply now to bring your engineering expertise to Citi and help shape the technology solutions that serve clients and markets around the world.
